questions.q: Where was Jonah trying to go when he boarded the ship?
What was Jonah doing while the mariners cried to their gods?
options: Sleeping in the innermost part of the ship

questions.q: How did the sailors find out who was responsible for the storm?
options: The ship master had a dream

questions.q: What did the men do right after Jonah told them to throw him into the sea?
options: Rowed hard to get back to land

questions.q: I am a Hebrew, and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who has made ____.
questions.answer: the sea and the dry land

questions.q: The ship master said, What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, ____!
Jonah was in the belly of the fish ____.

items: Jonah finds a ship at Joppa
A great storm hits the sea

questions.q: After the sea grew calm, the sailors offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows.
The ship master was the first to suggest throwing Jonah into the sea.
From where did Jonah pray to the LORD in chapter 2?
What does Jonah say was wrapped around his head in the deep?
Even when he felt banished from God's sight, what did Jonah say he would look toward?
According to Jonah's prayer, what do those who regard vain idols forsake?
But I will sacrifice to you ____. I will pay that which I have vowed.
wrong: with a whole and humble heart

questions.q: The flood was all around me. All your waves and ____ passed over me.
I went down to ____. The earth barred me in forever.
At the end of the chapter, the fish vomited Jonah out onto dry land.
Jonah says the LORD did not answer when he called out in his affliction.
In his prayer, Jonah says the sailors threw him into the depths.
What message did Jonah cry out in Nineveh?
options: In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown
In three days, Nineveh will burn
Repent, or your king will die
Nineveh will be given to Israel

questions.q: What did the king of Nineveh do when the news reached him?
options: Took off his robe and sat in ashes
Fled from the city by night

questions.q: Who did the king's decree say must not eat or drink?
options: Only the men of the city

questions.q: By whose decree was the fast published through Nineveh?
Let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence ____.
Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from ____, so that we might not perish?
The LORD's word came to Jonah ____, saying, Arise, go to Nineveh.

items: God tells Jonah to go to Nineveh again
Jonah announces the city will be overthrown
The people fast and put on sackcloth

questions.q: God saw that the people turned from their evil way and did not bring the disaster.
The people of Nineveh put on sackcloth only after the king ordered it.
How did Jonah react when God spared Nineveh?
options: He went home to his country
He offered thanks at the temple

questions.q: What question did the LORD ask Jonah in response to his angry prayer?
options: Is it right for you to be angry?
Why did you run to Tarshish?
Where were you when Nineveh repented?

questions.q: What destroyed the vine that shaded Jonah?
Where did Jonah sit to watch what would happen to the city?
options: On the east side of the city
On top of the city wall
On a hill to the west

questions.q: Therefore now, LORD, take my life from me, for it is better for me ____.
wrong: to be silent than to speak

questions.q: When the sun arose, God prepared ____, and the sun beat on Jonah's head.
Shouldn't I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, which has more than one hundred twenty thousand persons, and also ____?

items: Jonah asks the LORD to take his life
Jonah makes a booth outside the city
God makes a vine grow for shade

questions.q: Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.
When God asked whether he was right to be angry about the vine, Jonah admitted he was wrong.
